read: 2026-10-14, by eye from the schematic in PedalBuilder's forum post
comment: PedalBuilder's PTD Rotobone build (drawing titled 'The Elements of Fuzz', rev 1.0): a Jordan Boss Tone derivative with the output PNP installed emitter to ground, silicon/germanium switches for both transistor positions, a Low/High Power switch adding a Q1 emitter resistor, an Octave (voltage) pot, and 1P8T rotaries choosing the input (Y) and output (X) capacitors.
uncertain: R101: LED resistor drawn as 'LEDR' with no value
Q1 Element, Q2 Element, Low/High Power: switch types are not printed; read from the poles drawn
rows: under the Gain pot so it never mutes
LED current limiting resistor, drawn as LEDR
silicon, hFE 424 on the drawing; the post's build used a Central Semiconductor 2N5088, hFE 460
germanium, hFE 110, leakage 10µA on the drawing; the post's build used a General Instrument 2N1304, hFE 123
silicon, hFE 225 on the drawing; the post's build used an ON Semiconductor 2N4403, hFE 186
germanium, hFE 174, leakage 137µA on the drawing; the post's build used a TI 182505 (2N404A equivalent), hFE 178
adds R6 to the Q1 emitter
input capacitor selector (1P8T from the post)
output capacitor selector (1P8T from the post)
